## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D first-person chess game where the player commands one figure alongside bot teammates against bot opponents, with combat animations on captures and checkmate.

## Requirements
- Implement the game now without clarifying questions.
- Include combat animations for defeated figures and king checkmate.
- Make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.

## Decisions
- Built a browser-based 3D chess game with Three.js, standard chess rules, a move-selecting player, and an autonomous opponent.
- Added a commander camera focused on the selected figure plus a tactical overhead view.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the game interface, responsive styling, custom 3D board and chess pieces, legal move selection, bot turns, captures, undo/restart, and checkmate/result screens.
- Added combat particle bursts and falling-piece animations.
- `node --check game.js` and `node --check server.js` passed.
- Opened the game in Playwright and confirmed selecting the E2 pawn reports two legal moves.
- Saved and inspected `screenshots/arena.jpg`.

### Active
- Fix and validate any gameplay/UI issues found in a broader browser playthrough.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Reload the browser to test the latest changes to roster entries and capture animations.
2. Play through several turns, verify bot moves and undo, and address any errors.
3. Optionally add a favicon to eliminate the browser’s lone 404 (`/favicon.ico`).

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI and modals.
- `style.css`: Responsive interface styling.
- `game.js`: Three.js scene, chess rules, bot logic, controls, and animations.
- `server.js`: Local static-file server.
- `package.json`: Start script (`npm start`).
- `screenshots/arena.jpg`: Most recent visual check.

## Important Context
- The game runs at `http://localhost:3002` via `npm start` / `node server.js`.
- Browser console showed one error for missing `/favicon.ico`; WebGL performance warnings were also reported.

- Build a complete, playable 3D first-person chess game where the player commands one figure alongside bot teammates against bot opponents, with combat animations on captures and checkmate.

## Requirements
- Implement the game without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.

- Added a commander camera focused on the selected figure plus a tactical overhead view.
